The commit 2b760fcf5cfb (""ipv6: hook up exception table to store
dst cache"") partially reverted the commit 1e2ea8ad37be (""ipv6: set
dst.obsolete when a cached route has expired"").
As a result
column2: RTF_CACHE dst referenced outside the fib tree will

column1: not be removed until the next sernum change; dst_check() does not
fail on aged-out dst
column2: and dst->__refcnt can't decrease: the aged

column1: out dst will stay valid for a potentially unlimited time after the
timeout expiration.
This change explicitly removes RTF_CACHE dst from the fib tree when
aged out. The rt6_remove_exception() logic will then obsolete the
dst and other entities will drop the related reference on next
dst_check().
pMTU exceptions are not aged-out
column2: and are removed from the exception

column1: table only when the - usually considerably longer - ip6_rt_mtu_expires
timeout expires.
- do not touch dst.obsolete in rt6_remove_exception()
- take care of pMTU exceptions
Fixes: 2b760fcf5cfb (""ipv6: hook up exception table to store dst cache"")
